acceptanceCriteria: The dispatcher excludes a detached supervisor from a worker's stopped tree only when its recorded PID and start identity match the run record; a mismatch or missing record keeps today's behaviour.
The heal hand-off of an ended worker defers (or transfers the holder) while a detached run for that attempt is RUNNING and live, within a stated bound; otherwise it releases as today.
dispatch status / reports show each attempt's detached run state (RUNNING, FINISHED, SUPERVISOR_LOST) read-only.
Maintained tests: a dispatcher-launched worker exits while its detached run continues and a successor attaches to the outcome; a forged run record does not exempt a process.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

V1-0856 (beamfall/corvint#627) added `run --attempt --detach` and `run --attach`, but dispatcher integration was deferred (docs/specs/corvint-tasks-attempt-runner-v0.md, Detached runs, remaining work). Under the dispatcher a detached run is still stopped: CAL-V0-056 `refreshTree` adopts children of recorded members by parent PID, so the setsid supervisor can be counted in the worker tree and stopped, and the heal hand-off releases an ended worker's attempt, which fences the run within one beat. Both changes need an owner decision on identity-verified exclusion of a recorded supervisor and on deferred hand-off or holder transfer.
